description: §5.2 rule 2, S457 bullet `srcdoc` in every form: the UNQUOTED expression form `srcdoc=${@doc}` puts data into an HTML document and is refused, exactly as the quoted `srcdoc="${…}"` form is.
rationale: §5.2 rule 2 (S457): "A `srcdoc` attribute (any case) on an element whose value is not a static string — the expression form `srcdoc=${…}`, a variable …, a call …, a value a component prop supplies — SHALL be a compile error (E-ATTR-INTERP-EXECUTABLE)". Before S457 it compiled clean and wrote `setAttribute("srcdoc", String(value))` — the data ran as HTML (g-srcdoc-unquoted-expression-not-refused-s457).
